selected_evidence.requirement: Run the worker as the managed `inventory-worker` service
selected_evidence.summary: The validated unit invokes the required worker, is enabled and active, and recovered automatically after reboot.
The account is dedicated, locked, non-login, and has no supplementary groups. Live `/proc`, process, and cgroup evidence shows the service runs with UID/GID 992 and NoNewPrivileges enabled.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release, kernel, worker, and security/access controls
selected_evidence.summary: Before-and-after evidence shows RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 unchanged, the worker checksum unchanged, SELinux enforcing, SSH active, and the SSH configuration checksum preserved.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery proof
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID was 7ef78016-ba83-4481-867b-e5a349df1b54; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the recovered boot ID was 0a23f1e5-1ce7-4930-a3d9-868a6b7e9568; post-restart evidence proves system health, SSH access, unchanged data checksums, and automatic service recovery under `inventorysvc`.
